read: A macro rout dominated: the Nasdaq fell 5.5% and the S&P 500 4.4% on Thursday, the worst day since April 2025, as AI and chip stocks sold off on midterm fallout. Healthcare fell 2.5%, so it held up comparatively well; I could not find a verified XBI or NBI close. Within the sector, the signal was mixed. RevMed's Rasonque booked $198m in roughly five weeks, which says a well-differentiated oncology drug can still launch steeply. Novartis' disclosure of tumour reports after Zolgensma reopens the AAV integration debate. Capital keeps flowing to China-sourced assets (Evommune and Caldera this week, after Boehringer–Sino and AbbVie–Nxera), even as Beijing tightens the investigator-initiated trial route that gave China its speed edge. Net: fundamentals and dealmaking are constructive (AZ is still circling Rhythm, and London-based T-Therapeutics drew a $133m round), but expect beta to the wider tape until the AI-driven selloff settles.

items.headline: US equities: Nasdaq –5.5%, S&P 500 –4.4%, worst day since April 2025; healthcare –2.5%
items.detail: AI and semiconductor stocks led the selloff (tech –8%) on fears that Democratic midterm gains mean tighter rules for data centres, and all 11 sectors fell. The Russell 2000 fell 4.5%, so healthcare was a relative outperformer. I could not verify an XBI or NBI close.

items.headline: Novartis confirms 9 tumour reports in Zolgensma-treated patients, 2 with evidence of vector integration
items.detail: This covers more than 6,000 patients treated since 2019, and seven of the reports were newly disclosed. Causality has not been established outside the two integration cases. SMA Europe says regulators are assessing the evidence. A vector-integration signal in a commercial AAV product affects the whole class (including Novartis' intrathecal follow-on) and comes as gene therapy sentiment is already fragile.

items.headline: Revolution Medicines: Rasonque (daraxonrasib) books $197.6m in its first ~5 weeks on the market
items.detail: Approved 26 August for 2L+ metastatic PDAC. The figure includes initial channel stocking and compares with Truist's $19m estimate. CHMP has given a positive opinion, the 1L PDAC combination has Breakthrough designation, and cash is $3.7bn. RASolve 301 in NSCLC finishes enrolling this month, with a readout in 2027. BioPharma Dive calls it the best cancer drug launch on record.

items.headline: AstraZeneca/Rhythm: reported ~$10bn approach still live, with analysts flagging a possible bidding war
items.detail: Reuters reports a non-binding offer worth up to $134/share including milestones, with Alexion leading; the WSJ cited $124/share. RYTM rose 28% on Wednesday to $110.68 and AZN rose 3%. Neither company has confirmed. This broke during Wednesday's US session and is repeated here as a follow-up; there was no new confirmation overnight.

items.headline: FDA grants accelerated approval to J&J's subcutaneous Rybrevant Faspro (amivantamab) in 2L+ recurrent/metastatic HNSCC
items.detail: OrigAMI-4 (n=102): ORR 42%, CR 15%, mPFS 6.8 months, mOS 12.5 months, with fatal adverse reactions in 6%. HPV+ oropharyngeal disease is excluded. This puts EGFR-directed antibodies firmly into H&N, read-across for Genmab's petosemtamab (positive in 1L Phase 3).

items.headline: AASLD: Merck's efinopegdutide (GLP-1/glucagon, from Hanmi) gives 63% MASH resolution vs 13% on placebo at 7mg in Phase 2b biopsy data
items.detail: This keeps dual agonists competitive in MASH against semaglutide and Madrigal's Rezdiffra. Fibrosis data were not visible in the report.

items.headline: Evommune in-licenses Hinova's oral VAV1 molecular glue degrader (EVO570) for up to $1.1bn
items.detail: Upfront is $30m ($20m cash plus $10m in pre-funded warrants), with royalties ex-China and a Phase 2 in RA planned for 2027. Typical China-sourced structure with a small upfront and a headline driven by biobucks.

items.headline: T-Therapeutics (Cambridge, UK) raises a $133m Series B for TCR-CD3 bispecifics in solid tumours and autoimmune disease
items.detail: Co-led by Advent Life Sciences and the British Business Bank, with JJDC, Eli Lilly, Samsara and M Ventures joining. A large UK round with two pharma strategics participating.

items.headline: ANI Pharmaceuticals makes a recommended ~SEK 5.6bn (~$560m) cash offer for Egetis Therapeutics (Emcitate, MCT8 deficiency)
items.detail: SEK 11.25/share, with ~42% of holders committed. Funded with cash plus JPMorgan debt, needs 90% acceptance, and the acceptance period runs about 20 November to 18 December. It comes a day after Egetis sold its rare paediatric PRV for $190m.

items.headline: China restricts investigator-initiated trials after patient deaths, slowing its fast and cheap first-in-human route
items.detail: This hits the US biotechs and in-licensors that used Chinese IITs to compress early timelines. Watch for knock-on effects on how fast China-sourced assets generate data and how they are priced.

items.headline: Alethio Therapeutics (Oxford spinout) raises a $90m (£67m) Series A for an anti-G6b antibody in myeloproliferative neoplasms
items.detail: Co-led by Sofinnova and RA Capital, with an ADC for myelofibrosis to follow. Preclinical.

items.headline: Caldera in-licenses an IL-17xTL1A bispecific from existing partner Qyuns Therapeutics
items.detail: Terms not visible in the report. One more China-sourced I&I bispecific.

items.headline: Kamau Therapeutics reports first data for nula-cel 2.0, its revamped sickle cell gene-editing therapy
items.detail: Three patients with no pain crises or transfusion needs. This revives the asset after the earlier Graphite Bio failure. US launch targeted for 2028.

items.headline: Amgen: large real-world study links Repatha to ~20% lower heart attack risk than ezetimibe
items.detail: Supportive for PCSK9 positioning as oral PCSK9s approach.

items.headline: Former Madrigal executive sues, alleging a cover-up of Rezdiffra safety issues
items.detail: These are allegations only so far. Relevant to the MASH franchise narrative as Madrigal presents real-world data at AASLD.

items.headline: Genmab 9M revenue $3.24bn (+22%), Epkinly sales $491m (+47%), 2026 guidance held
items.detail: Rina-S (RAINFOL-02, PROC) and petosemtamab (LiGeR-HN1, 1L H&N) Phase 3 wins head to regulators.

items.headline: Novartis' Avidity unit to lay off 40 in San Diego
items.detail: Comes after Novartis recently wrote down part of the Avidity deal.

items.headline: bit.bio raises a $25m Series D
items.detail: From M&G Investments and Abcam founder Jonathan Milner, for stem cell-derived human cell types for discovery.

items.headline: Sigma Biotech raises a Series A+ (first close) of several hundred million yuan
items.detail: Led by China Life Equity. Organoids plus AI drug discovery.
